title: AuditLogs
description: Audit log results with keyset pagination.

paging.description: Paging object that can be used for navigation.

id.description: The identifier of the audit action.

time.description: Timestamp in RFC3339 format when the action was taken.

user_id.description: The user identifier of the actor who performed the audit action.

user_guid.description: The user GUID of the actor who performed the audit action.

event_description.description: A human-readable description of the action.

cursors.description: Cursor values for navigating between pages.

KeysetPaging.description: Keyset-based pagination metadata with cursors and navigation links.

previous.description: A cursor ID that can be used with the previous query parameter to get the previous page of results.

next.description: A cursor ID that can be used with the next query parameter to get the next page of results.

first.description: A full URL of the first page of results. Null if the current response is the first page.

previous.description: A full URL of the previous page of results. Null if the current response is the first page.

next.description: A full URL of the next page of results. Null if the current response is the last page.

last.description: A full URL of the last page of results. Null if the current response is the last page.
